name: – Elissavet Vozemberg-Vrionidi – Commission proposal and amendments
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council empowering Austria to amend its existing bilateral road transport agreement with Switzerland with a view to authorising cabotage operations in the course of the provision of international road passenger transport services by coach and bus in the border regions between the two countries
part_text:
Austria wants to change its 1958 road transport agreement with Switzerland. The change would let coaches and buses pick up and drop off passengers inside the other country's border area during international trips. This is called cabotage. European Union rules normally reserve this for carriers holding an EU licence, so Austria needs the EU's permission. The report supports giving Austria that permission, limited to named border districts in Vorarlberg and Tyrol, as long as no carrier is discriminated against and competition is not distorted.

- **What changes:** The EU would allow Austria to permit cross-border coach and bus cabotage with Switzerland in set border districts.
- **Who it affects:** Coach and bus operators and people travelling between Austria and Switzerland's border regions.
- **What happens next:** Parliament votes on this position; the final decision is then taken with EU governments.
